title: Cost-aware Role Suggester — Onboarding & RBAC Setup Prototype
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a compact onboarding flow in the Console that suggests workspace roles based on intended usage patterns and estimated inference cost impact. The prototype combines RBAC choices, role templates, and a lightweight cost estimator so platform teams can choose least-privilege roles while understanding downstream token and capacity cost implications.
goals: Reduce setup friction for new workspaces by surfacing recommended role templates
Make cost impact of role choices (e.g., ability to create high-throughput endpoints) visible during onboarding
Encourage least-privilege defaults while allowing quick overrides for power users
Provide audit-ready justification text that can be exported to the workspace audit log
user_stories: As a platform admin, I want role recommendations tailored to my team's intended usage pattern (dev/test/production) so I can set safe defaults quickly
As an infra lead, I want to see an estimated token and GPU-hour impact of granting 'Model Deploy' permissions so I can approve capacity commitments
As a compliance officer, I want an exportable justification for each granted role to save into our audit record
acceptance_criteria: Prototype screens for 3 onboarding scenarios (Individual dev, Small team, Enterprise) exist in Figma
Cost estimator shows per-month token and approximate GPU-hour delta for each role template
Onboarding flow records chosen role and justification to the audit log mock endpoint
Usability test (n=8) with PM/engineer participants shows >= 80% success for choosing an appropriate role
prototype_notes: Compact card-based role templates at left, expanded details at right (mobile-first collapse)
Estimator uses recent workspace token velocity + model profile heuristics to compute a conservative cost delta
Justification field is auto-populated with suggested text that can be edited by the admin; changes are captured in audit log entry
Default selection for new workspaces is 'Developer (least privilege)'; secondary CTA 'Enable fast deploy' opens extra confirmation modal explaining cost and SLO tradeoffs
tradeoffs_considered: Showing hard cost numbers vs ranges: ranges chosen to avoid false precision but may reduce perceived accuracy
Automated role suggestion complexity vs transparency: we chose an explicit 'why suggested' tooltip rather than an opaque ML-driven recommendation
Embedding cost estimator in onboarding increases latency of flow; solution: async estimation with placeholder ranges and final confirmation before commit
decisions: Use role templates (Developer, Team Lead, Operator, Billing Admin) instead of full custom role creation during initial onboarding
Expose only estimated monthly deltas (tokens, estimated GPU-hours) and a qualitative cost impact label (low/medium/high)
Persist chosen justification and template name to the audit log as part of the onboarding event payload
